cards.label: 3:14 AM
cards.text: Something woke you up. You lie still for a moment, cataloguing the sounds of the building. The boiler. A fox outside. Then: footsteps, not from the corridor. From inside.
Someone's in the flat. Moving carefully, which is almost worse than if they were crashing around - it means they've done this before.
You grab the nearest thing to hand - which, for better or worse, is the torch you left by the bed after last week when the power went out - and go to meet them.
